content: We need count of aromatic carbons in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the sample is implicit? Maybe we need to retrieve NMR spectra to infer aromatic carbons? But we don't have SMILES. Could be that the environment has a sample at hand (the current compound). We can get carbon NMR spectra which will list chemical shifts; aromatic carbons appear around 110-160 ppm. Could count peaks in that region. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
